patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Grasshopper and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Grasshopper only if your buying job matches “SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (f” rather than Zoom's shape. Choose Zoom only if your buying job matches “Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floo” rather than Grasshopper's shape. Workflow advantage: Grasshopper leans shared coverage; Zoom leans team-communication. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Grasshopper and Zoom share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Grasshopper is SMB virtual business numbers with extensions and apps — True Solo from $14/month annual (flat account, not per seat).; Zoom is Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited research floor ~$15–16/user/month; free meetings/chat exist but.
- Company-size focus: Grasshopper (solo, small-business) vs Zoom (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Grasshopper-leaning — vs Zoom-leaning team-communication.
- Researched limits: Grasshopper — Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); Zoom — Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service.

Limitations — Grasshopper: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite); IVR, recording and simultaneous ringing require Solo Plus or above; Zoom: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service; Phone seat floors and Pro Plus / Business Plus bundles are medium confidence and region-sensitive.

Poor-fit cases: Grasshopper is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Virtual-number / simple phone product — not full UCaaS (no native team chat or video meetings suite) · Zoom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free Workplace covers meetings/chat — not full Zoom Phone PSTN service · Avoid Grasshopper if you actually need Zoom's motion (Meetings-first Workplace suite plus Zoom Phone UCaaS — Phone US/CA Unlimited res)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
